the same plan family, graph family, shape and trip count as c03 at a warp count with no evidence: the retained-backedge study measured 1 and 4 warps only, and retained-loop-probe.md records 8 warps keeping a loop at 4 and 8 warps on the same region class

the family earlier runs refused on graph grounds - 'no value is read by two reduction nodes' on the fold, mixed-depth and cross-state graphs - on a graph that admits it, at a warp count with no evidence (the plan sweep measured 1 and 4 warps at [8, 8] only)

the family whose declared consumer views produced no conversion at all in the plan sweep (gluon-plan-sweep.md section 6, 'not reached'), on a loop-composed region at another trip count (2) and warp count (4)

input_replication.basis: the four inputs of a program are compared by the digest of each IR stage and of the pass dump after this run's own IR directory path, which MLIR prints in every source location and PTX repeats inside its DWARF string table, is replaced by a placeholder and PTX's DWARF data lines are removed
